rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates the amount landlords may increase rent for most multifamily buildings; properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control, and landlords of 5 or more units must register and may seek rent increases only through approved application types (e.g., capital improvement, hardship, annual CPI-based increases).
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental properties with 5 or more units that are registered under the Rent Leveling Board system; certain exemptions apply per the ordinance's criteria.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the property qualifies for a permitted rent control exemption under the ordinance's criteria

rules.conflict_note: The chunk does not provide the specific percentage cap or formula used for permitted rent increases under the ordinance; only the registration/exemption framework is described.
